_comment: Hand-maintained re-entry rows for the scorecard: a position taken AGAIN in a ticker that already has a row (the first trade closed, stopped or sold). Scorecard picks are auto-derived from articles and keyed by ticker, so one article can only ever produce one row; a re-entry is a separate trade and gets its own row here. Each entry needs its own `anchor` (unique DOM id — the article hero keeps deep-linking to the ORIGINAL row) and carries NO forcedStop / reduced: its trailing stop is scanned live from its own entry date. `issueDate` is the session the position was taken and is displayed on the row ('entered <date>'), since a re-entry has no article byline to date it. `entryPrice` is the actual fill; omit it to fall back to the standard rule (first close strictly after issueDate). Read by build.js -> appended to scorecard-recos.json. See wiki/scorecard.md 'Re-entry rows'.
